_note: Which old-database contributions count as canon for the atlas. Only canon notes are published into atlas/data/notes.json; everything else is held back and listed in tools/source/canon_review.md. Owner ids come from the old site's users table (1 = Shawn Nicolen, 2 = Jacob McDonald). Decision 2026-10-19: Shawn's and Jacob's entries are canon; every other contributor is ignored.

thirdPartyOwners._why: Published game-system content (WotC, Malhavoc, Sean K. Reynolds, Ironsoul, ...). Never published on the atlas.

overrides._why: Per-entry decisions by database id: "canon" forces inclusion, "exclude" forces omission.
